whatsNew: Admin can now open App Updates directly from the Admin Console Quick Actions.
The admin controls exactly when the Android update popup is sent to users.
Admin accounts do not receive the release update popup.
The web release endpoint uses no-cache responses so newly triggered releases are picked up immediately.
Staged releases stay hidden until the admin manually triggers the update.
